messages.author: fc5d3270037d7478
messages.subject: append_row error
parts:
This might be a stupid question (i.e. maybe I've just missed something obvious), but I was having some trouble using append_row to concatenate vectors in a complicated model, so I made a little toy example to see if it gave me the same error and it does. Here's the toy example:

parameters {
  real x ;
}

model {
  vector[2] a_vec ;
  vector[2] b_vec ;
  vector[4] c_vec ;
  
  a_vec <- rep_vector(1, 2) ;
  b_vec <- rep_vector(2, 2) ;
  c_vec <- append_row(a_vec, b_vec) ;
  print("c_vec = ", c_vec) ;

  x ~ normal(0,1) ;
}

The code compiles fine but then when it runs (using RStan) it says it's rejecting metropolis proposals because of the following error

error in call to assign(Eigen::Matrix,Eigen::Matrix); shapes must match, but found R1=-1; C1=1; R2=-1; C2=-1

and then after a lot of these messages I get 

Rejecting proposed initial error occurred during calling the sampler; sampling not done

and it stops. If I remove the append_row line it runs fine.  Am I overlooking something or is this a bug? 

Thanks a lot, 

Jonah

messages.author: fc5d3270037d7478
messages.subject: Re: append_row error
parts: One more thing that may or may not be helpful: if I change all of the vectors to row vectors and use append_col instead of append_row I don't get the error. It works fine.

messages.author: 8aa9b8cc06fdc99c
messages.subject: Re: [stan-users] append_row error
parts:
This is indeed a bug and I opened an issue:

https://github.com/stan-dev/stan/issues/1241

Thanks for reporting. The return type's
wrong on the C++ side and I should be able to get
it fixed for 2.6.0.

- Bob
